Delete/Informationen loeschen is only acceptable as documented cleanup after confirming the exact temporary number in the dialog and proving the filtered list is empty afterwards.
After FIXEDASSETS-028, do not run another open-ended preflight on New; either save exactly FA-CNC-01 under the gate or abort and clean up.
Do not proceed from saved FA-CNC-01 directly to K30000, purchase invoice, acquisition or depreciation; those need later gates.
FIXEDASSETS-031 proves direct page 5600 card opening is safer than accepting list text when card values are required.
After FIXEDASSETS-031, HGB and MACHINES on FA-CNC-01 are only partial master-data proof; Description, Class/Subclass and depreciation years/dates remain blockers.

Field diagnosis must distinguish visible label, visible value and editable control; one editable depreciation field does not prove all card fields are editable.

After FIXEDASSETS-139, FA-CNC-01 still visibly carries Posting Group EQUIPMENT. Do not claim MACHINES as assigned until a field-specific Posting Group combobox/lookup route selects MACHINES and the card proves it after reopen.
After FIXEDASSETS-140, the attempted Posting Group route opened the related Depreciation Book Card HGB. Treat related-record foreground navigation as a stop condition, not as a combobox success.
